references.text: Caiaphas prophesies that it is better for the people that one man die for the people, creating an ironic contrast to Thomas's willingness to die together with Jesus.
The disciples warn Jesus that the Jews recently tried to stone him, providing context for Thomas's fear that they will die together with him.
Jesus later expresses the principle Thomas acts on: 'No one has greater love than the one who gives his life for his friends'.
Peter asks Jesus why he cannot follow him now and expresses willingness to give his life, mirroring Thomas's readiness to follow Jesus to death.
